verdict.rationale: The SDK has a documented model download API that streams detailed DownloadProgress events, which touches model management. It also supports system prompts set per exchange. Nothing shows a single place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations together. Missing for 10: a unified management interface or CLI, listing and deleting downloaded models, persisted or saved prompt libraries, per-model configuration storage, and any hands-on corroboration.
